page: Amazon Web Services t8i.small is a burstable performance server instance belonging to the t8i family. It is powered by an Intel x86_64 processor operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The instance features 2 virtual CPUs (vCPUs) mapped to 1 physical core with 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 2.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core. The instance runs on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage or bundled GPUs. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Because the CPU allocation is burstable, the instance is designed to handle temporary spikes in compute demand rather than sustained, high-utilization workloads. The lack of dedicated local storage and baseline network bandwidth represents a tradeoff optimized for low-cost, low-throughput operations.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the t8i.small offers a budget-friendly entry point for workloads with low resource density. It is suitable for lightweight applications, microservices, development and testing environments, and low-traffic web serving where continuous high CPU performance is not required.
